thread:
megan: Quick sync 1 00: final copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private page trio + launch post and webinar promo. Need approved hero + toggles by 5pm PT.

dave: I can do mode toggle edits and the small benchmark ribbon. Single hero or three heroes?
sara: Single concise hero, yes. Mode toggles underneath with 1-line benefits.
leo: Draft hero: 'Predictable, production-grade inference 1 wherever you run it.' Subline: 'One API: Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.'
megan: Good. Make subline: 'One API for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private inference with consistent operational controls.'
ria: Toggle copy ideas: Hosted: 'Hosted API 1 start fast, usage-based pricing, free credits'; Dedicated: 'Dedicated 1 reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed throughput'; Private: 'Private 1 VPC, HSM/KMS, on-prem bundles & audit logs.'
ashley: Launch post lead: short narrative + perf highlights + webinar CTA. Lead sentence suggestion: 'Today we debut a unified inference platform that makes LLMs predictable at production scale 1 whether you want hosted simplicity, reserved capacity, or private controls.'
dave: Benchmarks: small ribbon under hero: 'Benchmarks (median p50): Llama-2 family: 45ms p50; Mistral-like: 38ms p50 on Dedicated profile' with link to perf hub. Avoid competitor calls.
sara: Webinar blurb: 'Deep dive + live demo: reducing per-token cost via batching, prefix caching, and smart routing. Engineers welcome.' CTA: 'Reserve your spot' and secondary CTA: 'View benchmarks'.
megan: For inbound routing: webinar_signup -> marketing:webinar -> growth inbox; demo_request -> sales:demo -> AE queue. Include chosen_mode property if provided.
ria: YAML snippet for docs: ```yaml
routing:
  - event: webinar_signup
    tag: marketing:webinar
    dest: inbox:marketing-growth
  - event: demo_request
    tag: sales:demo
    dest: queue:ae
    props: [chosen_mode]
```
ashley: Add FAQ line under Private: 'Security: VPC peering, dedicated HSM/KMS, audit logs, SOC2-ready configs.'
dave: Can we add three bullets per toggle: Hosted: 'Fast onboarding, free credits, pay-as-you-go.' Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput, reserved GPUs, SLA.' Private: 'Network isolation, enterprise key mgmt, on-prem support.'
leo: Social post short: 'Predictable LLM inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Reserve our launch webinar to see benchmarks and a demo. #LLMInfra'
megan: Prefer 'predictable unit economics' instead of 'predictable LLM inference' in social line.
marketing-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 24h to lock hero variants for A/B tests.
megan: I'll compile final assets and post at 3pm. Drop edits here before 2:30pm. :thumbsup:
